nodes.description: Address of the oneToken owner authorized to change the oracle interval.
Chainlink AggregatorV3 spot price oracle address used for the spot price.
Decimals reported by the chainlink spot oracle, used for scaling.
Desired output decimals of the oracle price result.
Stored update period set by owner via changeInterval (interface requirement).
Mapping of pair index to UniswapPair struct holding TWAP accumulators, averages and timestamps.
Constant 1 hour TWAP window used when initialising the pair structs.
External function allowing only the owner to set the PERIOD state variable.
External function that loops over the two pairs, fetches cumulative prices and refreshes TWAP averages.
Internal view function converting an amountIn to a price using the stored pair averages.
Public view function computing the pWING/USDC TWAP price via two consult calls.
Public view function reading the chainlink latestRoundData and scaling to output decimals.
Public view function returning the lower of the hourly TWAP price and the chainlink spot price.
Constructor initialising pair structs, token addresses, owner and decimals.
Caller address used as the authorization check in changeInterval.
Block timestamp consumed when computing time elapsed for the TWAP update.
External call to UniswapV2OracleLibrary/pair contract inside update that pulls cumulative price data.
External call to the chainlink aggregator latestRoundData inside getSpotPrice.
Unchecked uint32 subtraction of last stored blockTimestamp from the current one where overflow is intended.
Parameter of changeInterval carrying the new period value.
Local variable in update holding the elapsed seconds since the last TWAP update.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner to gate changeInterval, so the caller controls whether the state-changing function executes.
The period_ parameter provided by the owner flows directly into the PERIOD state variable.
update derives timeElapsed from the miner-influenceable block.timestamp, making the TWAP refresh timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp based blockTimestamp is subtracted from the stored blockTimestampLast, an unchecked uint32 subtraction where wrap-around is intended.
The uint32 subtraction result feeds the update branch condition and average computation inside update.
update calls the external currentCumulativePrices library routine to obtain cumulative prices.
Externally fetched cumulative prices are written back into the pairs mapping state.
update writes refreshed price averages and timestamps into the pairs mapping.
timeElapsed local variable is computed and consumed inside the update loop.
consult reads the stored price averages from the pairs mapping.
getHourlyPrice invokes consult for both pair types.
The spotOracle state variable is used as the target of the chainlink read.
getSpotPrice performs the external latestRoundData call on the chainlink aggregator.
spotOracle_decimals controls the scaling arithmetic applied to the spot price result.
outputDecimals controls the scaling arithmetic applied to the spot price result.
getLatestPrice calls getHourlyPrice to obtain the TWAP price.
getLatestPrice calls getSpotPrice to obtain the chainlink spot price.
getHourlyPrice uses pair data indirectly through consult to build the TWAP price.
changeInterval writes the owner-supplied period into PERIOD, the privileged state modification.
The owner state variable is read as the authorization authority in changeInterval.
The constructor sets the owner state variable from the oneToken argument.
The constructor initialises the pairs mapping entries for both Uniswap pairs.
HOURLY constant is used as the PERIOD field of each initialised pair struct.
